angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 541,255 km at 6.54 pc = 1.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 152.8640 +/- 0.0494 mas (same row, RUWE 1.00): 6.54 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.778 +/- 0.005 solar radii from Gillon et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of HD 219134 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017NatAs...1E..56G/abstract): 541,255 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.81 +/- 0.03 solar masses from Gillon et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of HD 219134 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017NatAs...1E..56G/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4699 +/- 16 K from Gillon et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 219134 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017NatAs...1E..56G/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Gillon et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of HD 219134 c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017NatAs...1E..56G/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/hd-219134.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.565, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 219134 (pscomppars): spectral type K3 V, from Vogt et al. 2015 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2015ApJ...814...12V/abstract)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, HD 219134: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 219134 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0.11 dex, from Gillon et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017NatAs...1E..56G/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 219134 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.57741, from Gillon et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017NatAs...1E..56G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 219134 (pscomppars): age 11 Gyr, from Gillon et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017NatAs...1E..56G/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: VizieR J/ApJ/964/80/table1 (MgII line profiles & refined param. of FGKM stars), column Per: 43 d, the row 0.0 arcsec from the star's J2000 place. The middle of 2 catalogued periods, 2 of them within 20% of it

spinInclinationSource: Computed here from this record's rotation period, projected rotation speed and radius (0.778 solar radii): sin i = v sin i × P / (2πR) = 0.437. Not a measurement of the axis: the three numbers come from different papers.
